panelId.title: Vivint system (panel ID)
panelId.description: Only needed if your Vivint account has more than one system. On startup the log lists every system as 'Found Vivint system [PanelId]:... [Name]:...'. Leave empty to use the first one.

apiLoginRefreshSecs.title: API Refresh
apiLoginRefreshSecs.description: How often should Vivint Homebridge renew the session token.

ignoreDeviceTypes.title: Ignore Devices
ignoreDeviceTypes.description: Selected device types / equipment codes / IDs would be ignored on startup. Useful in case of external integrations like Nest or MyQ that may be managed directly by another Homebridge plugin.

logDeviceList.title: Show device list
logDeviceList.description: Shows data for all configured Vivint devices in the log

disableCameras.title: Disable cameras
disableCameras.description: If checked, camera video feeds would not appear in Homebridge.

useExternalVideoStreams.title: Use external video streams
useExternalVideoStreams.description: Stream camera feeds from Vivint servers instead of streaming directly from the Panel.

showCameraConfig.title: Show camera config
showCameraConfig.description: Shows configuration for all detected cameras in the log
